name: com.unscramblex/word-tools
title: UnscrambleX
description: Unscramble letters, check Scrabble and Words With Friends words, get spoiler-free daily game hints.

tools.name: unscramble_letters
tools.description: Find the words that can be made from a set of letters: a scrambled word, an anagram, or a Scrabble or Words With Friends rack. Each letter is used at most once; ? is a blank tile. Returns the top words (longest first, then most points), the count by length, the highest-scoring word and the url of the full list on unscramblex.com. Default 25 words, at most 50.

letters.description: The letters, 2 to 15, e.g. "aeinrt" or "retain?" (? = blank tile, 2 at most).

dictionary.description: Which dictionary: all = All dictionaries (NWL2023, CSW24, WOW24, Words With Friends); nwl = NWL2023 (NASPA Word List, Scrabble in the US and Canada); csw = CSW24 (Collins Scrabble Words, UK and international Scrabble); wow = WOW24 (WGPO lexicon); wwf = Words With Friends. Default all.

starts_with.description: Only words that start with these letters.

ends_with.description: Only words that end with these letters.

limit.description: How many words to return (default 25, at most 50).

tools.name: validate_word
tools.description: Check whether a word is valid in word games: in which dictionaries it is (NWL2023, CSW24, WOW24, Words With Friends), its Scrabble and Words With Friends points, the other words of the same letters, and its page on unscramblex.com.

dictionary.description: Which dictionary: all = All dictionaries (NWL2023, CSW24, WOW24, Words With Friends); nwl = NWL2023 (NASPA Word List, Scrabble in the US and Canada); csw = CSW24 (Collins Scrabble Words, UK and international Scrabble); wow = WOW24 (WGPO lexicon); wwf = Words With Friends. Default all.

tools.name: get_daily_hint
tools.description: Today's hints for a daily word game, without spoilers: nudge = the gentlest hints, category = one step more (Connections categories, every Strands hint, the Spelling Bee grid, every Pips region rule). Never the answers: the result links the day's page on unscramblex.com, where the answers stay behind a reveal. The day is New York's.
